mission: Red-team the NEW stroke-heuristic-4 absence-of-measurement gates introduced in e03: partially-measured rival wrists, measurement dropouts, gate-masking / coverage regressions, and adversarial fixtures that pass all gates yet are wrong.

datasetScope.realFootage: none — all cases are deterministic synthetic pose/speed geometry
datasetScope.heldOut: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched (not viewed, labeled, tuned against, or regenerated)

findings.title: Sparse rival-wrist measurement (1-3 frames) disarms the rival-unmeasured gate and permits a wrong-arm commit
findings.detail: sparseRivalWrongArmFixture: rival (left) wrist is the true striking arm but is measured in only 2 frames; dominant right wrist is fully measured and moving. v4's dominant_wrist_attribution_unverifiable_rival_unmeasured gate only fires at exactly 0 rival-measured frames, so the classifier commits FOREHAND at 0.80 confidence off the wrong arm. Sweep: 0 rival frames -> UNKNOWN (gate fires); 1-3 frames -> committed at 0.80.
findings.rootCause: The gate tests for total absence of rival measurement rather than sufficiency of rival measurement; 1-2 glimpsed frames are treated as full verification of arm attribution.

findings.title: Torso ratios just above the 0.6 collapse threshold still yield a false OVERHEAD
findings.detail: torsoCollapseBoundaryOverheadFixture: shoulder-high volley with contact 0.22 real torso-units above shoulders, torso extent biased to 0.62 of sequence median across the swing window. The collapse gate (TORSO_COLLAPSE_MEDIAN_RATIO=0.6) does not fire and normalized elevation inflates past the overhead threshold: committed OVERHEAD at 0.68. Sweep boundary: ratio <= 0.60 -> UNKNOWN (gate fires); 0.62-0.85 -> false OVERHEAD (0.63-0.68); >= 0.90 -> correct FOREHAND.
findings.rootCause: Hard 0.6 cliff: mild uniform torso-extent bias (0.60 < ratio < ~0.9) passes the gate but still distorts torso-normalized contact elevation enough to flip the label.

findings.title: Genuine deep-crouch dink below 60% median torso extent is falsely abstained
findings.detail: crouchDinkFixture: physically real crouch posture (torso extent genuinely ~0.55-0.58 of the standing median during the dink) trips torso_extent_collapsed_vs_sequence_median and returns UNKNOWN. Sweep coverage floor: ratio 0.50-0.58 -> UNKNOWN; ratio >= 0.60 -> correct FOREHAND at 0.80.
findings.rootCause: The collapse gate cannot distinguish measurement failure (tracker collapse) from genuine postural torso foreshortening; deep crouches are a legitimate pickleball posture (dinks).

findings.title: Fully occluded rival wrist abstains on a genuine, unambiguous forehand (v4 regression vs v3 lite port)
findings.detail: occludedRivalGenuineForehandFixture: dominant arm fully measured with a clean swing; rival wrist has 0 measured frames (occluded by body). v4 -> UNKNOWN (dominant_wrist_attribution_unverifiable_rival_unmeasured). The v3 lite port (packages/vision-geometry/src/strokeHeuristicLite.ts, stroke-heuristic-3) commits the correct FOREHAND on the same geometry, pinning the divergence.
findings.rootCause: Zero-rival-frame gate treats absence of rival measurement as disqualifying even when dominant-arm evidence is complete; coverage floor for the gate is exactly 1 rival-measured frame.

findings.title: Exactly 3 sub-floor speed samples fire the no-swing-energy gate even when clustered before a genuine swing
findings.detail: speedDropoutDuringSwingFixture: genuine fast drive whose mid-swing speed samples are dropped; the only surviving in-window samples are >= 3 low-energy readings before the swing. MIN_WINDOW_SPEED_SAMPLES=3 is met, all samples < NON_SWING_SPEED_FLOOR=0.25, so no_swing_energy_in_window fires -> UNKNOWN. Sweep: 0-2 sub-floor in-window samples -> committed FOREHAND at 0.76; >= 3 -> UNKNOWN.
findings.rootCause: Sample-count sufficiency test ignores temporal placement of the samples within the window; clustered pre-swing samples masquerade as a measured-still window.

findings.title: Temporally clustered wrist dropout produces a false stillness abstention despite 6 measured frames
findings.detail: clusteredDropoutLoopSwingFixture: genuine loop swing with ~0.01u of measured path, but all 6 measured wrist frames cluster in a near-still phase (alternating dropout pattern). Travel gate (NON_SWING_TRAVEL_FLOOR=0.05, MIN_TRAVEL_SAMPLE_FRAMES=5) sees enough frames yet only the still segment -> no_swing_motion_near_reference -> UNKNOWN.
findings.rootCause: Frame-count sufficiency again ignores temporal coverage: measured frames concentrated in one phase of the swing satisfy the count gate while missing the motion entirely.

sweepRows.rivalMeasuredFrames: 0..6 (gate fires only at 0; wrong-arm commit at 1-3)

validation.pnpm test: 545 passed | 4 skipped (48 files), includes the 9 new red-team tests

externalBlockers: none for this workstream — all cases are synthetic geometry; real-footage confirmation of these gate failure modes would require Mac/Apple Vision canonical pose extraction (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, unchanged from e03)
verdictRationale: Two confidently-wrong commit paths (wrong-arm commit with 1-3 rival frames; false OVERHEAD in the 0.62-0.85 torso-ratio band) plus four measured coverage regressions with exact floors, all pinned by deterministic tests.
